decisions.inventory: Each explicit received/arrived source row contributes an opening receipt when quantity is numeric. Quantity is spreadsheet purchase order units, not converted package counts. Exact SKU rows aggregate; rows without SKUs stay separate. Any unknown quantity in a SKU aggregate makes balance unknown.
decisions.purchaseDates: Use only explicit receivedDate for occurredDate; missing receipt dates stay null even when status says Arrived.
decisions.unknownReceivedQty: No numeric transaction for received rows lacking quantity; see unquantifiedReceivedRows.
decisions.images: Only product-page metadata images saved in verifiedProductImages; matched only by SKU or exact product title.
decisions.step: Only named STEP product labels are included; no `Part N`/`idNNN` labels, counts, or stock quantities.
decisions.slackStatus: Status values are populated only from public Slack recaps with explicit completion, start, percentage, unfinished, or in-progress evidence; plan-only task mentions retain null status.
decisions.taskSequence: Task candidates are ordered by their source activity date. Hard dependencies are added only for explicit prerequisite language. Slack critical-path work is prioritized from dated recap threads; no completion or exact due date is inferred when the source does not state one.
